description: This file defines the 'INativeJS' interface within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It declares a set of pure virtual methods for managing NativeJS applications, including initialization, creation, running, and termination of plugins, as well as retrieving existing applications.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: An interface for managing NativeJS applications, allowing initialization, creation, execution, retrieval, and termination of JavaScript-based plugins.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initialize the plugin to use a service object, given a Wayland display string.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitialize the plugin and clean up resources.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Create a new NativeJS application with specified options and output its assigned ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Run an existing NativeJS application given its ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Execute JavaScript code within the context of a NativeJS application identified by its ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieve details of all existing NativeJS applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminate and destroy a running NativeJS application given its ID.
